capabilities: render interactive charts inline inside notes
build and edit charts through a modal with live preview
store chart data as plain Markdown tables in fenced blocks
configure charts with YAML or raw ECharts options
generate chart blocks via AI coding agents using a provided skill
extras: Full block schema is documented separately in docs/schema.md; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author missed a modern chart plugin with self-contained blocks whose data stays readable and editable even without the plugin installed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in charting, and the author found existing chart options lacked self-contained, human-readable data blocks that fit an AI-assisted workflow.

relations.evidence: Advanced mode — pass a raw ECharts option object for full control over every chart property
If you use an agentic AI coding tool — Claude Code, Kiro, Codex, Pi

requires.name: agentic AI coding tool (e.g. Claude Code) for the AI generation skill

summary: Chart plugin that renders interactive charts (bar, line, pie, scatter, area, funnel, heatmap, sankey) inline in notes from Markdown-table data blocks.
